w: During the evening assembly in the Church hall, the church priest, Petre Nicolik, paid his respects to Swamishri by offering namaskar. Four-hundred and fifty people had afttended the evening Satsang assembly.

The evening assembly was dedicated to programme presentations by students of the Sanstha’s school, Swaminarayan Vidyamandir. Students presented a parliamentary discussion as to why there should not be a ban on all Swaminarayan Vidyamandir schools because they emphasise more on values than on academics in their curriculum. The staged presentation with questions and answers were very effective. In conclusion Swamishri summed up, saying, “It was Yogiji Maharaj’s wish to have a school and hostel in Gondal so that students could study properly. The school and hostel have also been established with the purpose to impart values. There is a need for both education and values for students. If there is no education then the country cannot progress, but if there are no values taught in education then one cannot develop the nation properly. Education without values destroys. By values we mean faith in God."

A spiritual seeker was being talked about before Pramukh Swami Maharaj. Because of his odd nature, this seeker was always a topic of discussion. So everyone was eagerly chiming in, and mainly his shortcomings were being discussed. Then, when Swamishri spoke of his glory, everyone looked within. Everyone prayed to Swamishri, saying, "Give us a vow that we will never fall into dislike and fault-finding."
Swamishri repeated those same words with emphasis and said, "Decide that we will never fall into dislike and fault-finding. We will keep only an understanding of glory."

A spiritual seeker came to meet Pramukh Swami Maharaj. He said, "Now I have retired. What should I do from now on?"
Swamishri said, "Worship God, do as much seva as you can, and keep coming to satsang, and there will be happiness and peace."

Pramukh Swami Maharaj was taking his walk. Meanwhile Akhanddarshan Swami recited some verses of the 'Raghuvamsha' from memory. As talk turned to Sanskrit literature, a sadhu spoke about the teaching method of Kaundinya Shastri. He taught so well that all the sadhus living in Sarangpur at that time developed a great interest in studying Sanskrit. Moreover, his way of teaching was such that all the verses were memorised in the class itself. He had stayed in Sarangpur for only a short time.

As this talk about him came up, the sadhu further said, "He had a wish that when the guru came to the class, everyone should do dandvat (full prostration). Also, that when the guru's wife came to the mandir, there would be no sin in having darshan of the guru's wife."
Hearing this, Swamishri immediately said, "God is Gurunam Guru (the guru of gurus), and that God has forbidden doing such things."
A seeker came to meet Pramukh Swami Maharaj. He said, "Now I have retired. What should I do next?"
Swamishri said, "Do Bhagwan's bhajan, do as much seva as you can, and keep coming to satsang, then there will be happiness and peace."

st.t: A Spiritual Travelogue of Pramukh Swami Maharaj - Dummas, 15 June 2011
w: From 11.53 pm to 3.35 am Swamishri attended the assembly held during the lunar eclipse. Sadhus sang dhun and bhajans and gave discourses, and youths performed humorous skits with telling messages in the assembly.

ds.p: On the flight from Delhi to London
w: After the meal today, the senior pilot, Jeremy Palmer, came to meet Mahant Swami Maharaj. He also has a part in important decisions of British Airways.

He said to Swamishri, "Minesh is my friend. Because of him I got the chance to come close to you. I have been to the London mandir too. I also know about Pramukh Swami Maharaj, but I did not get the chance to have his darshan in person. Today I had darshan of Pramukh Swami Maharaj in you. Through you I met Pramukh Swami Maharaj. And I feel as if I have met God. I will tell my monks, priests and nuns about this experience." As he said this, tears welled up in Jeremy's eyes.
Taking Swamishri's hands in his own, he began to press them lovingly. The sadhus seated him in the seat facing Swamishri. He said, "I am a devout Christian follower."
Strengthening his experience further, Swamishri said, "Closer to God!"
Jeremy also said, "I feel that I am close to you. I and our priests will pray for you in church. I will tell them all about you."
Then he said, "Minesh and I are friends. There are two things in common that make us friends. One is God, and the other is that both of us have met God through you."
Jeremy's heart too admitted that a sadhu like Swamishri is the very form of Hari.

ds.p: On the flight from Delhi to London
w: Roshan, a young man who does seva in letter writing, told Mahant Swami Maharaj about a woman employee on this plane. Roshan said, "When I met this lady, she said, 'I am not on duty today, but I have come on this plane as a passenger so that I could have darshan of Mahant Swami Maharaj. I never had darshan of Pramukh Swami Maharaj in person, but through Mahant Swami Maharaj I have had darshan of Pramukh Swami Maharaj.'

And then the lady said, 'Today I understood the meaning of brahmacharya from Mahant Swami Maharaj's eyes. I have read that radiance comes from the eyes of one who observes brahmacharya. I had that experience at the time of Mahant Swami Maharaj's darshan.'"
The devotees suggested, "Let us send her prasad."

Other things were about to be sent as prasad, when Swamishri said to give chocolate. Learning of this, the lady was overcome with emotion and wept: "Swamishri, knowing my heart, knew my liking and sent me prasad of the chocolate I love."

ds.p: On the flight from Delhi to London
w: Today the weather department had forecast that while passing over Afghanistan, it was very likely that thunderstorm clouds would get in the way. Mahant Swami Maharaj had given the blessing, "There will be no problem." And truly, there were no such clouds there at all.
The senior pilot, Jerry Palmer, was greatly impressed by this power of Swamishri.
In connection with this incident, Hitesh Contact asked Swamishri, "All these people have such experiences in one go, and we stay with you all the time, so why do we not have such experiences?"
Swamishri smiled and said, "To live together and still understand the glory is the fifth ghat (the hardest of passes)."
Smiles played on everyone's faces.

Mahant Swami Maharaj came to the welcome assembly being held in the Swaminarayan Haveli. In it, it was mentioned that "Swamishri has come here from the airport after casting his glance on the new plots of land."

Regarding casting his glance on those lands and on the devotees who were fasting, Swamishri had a correction made, saying, "Announce that it was not I but Harikrishna Maharaj who cast his glance on the land on the way, and that he also casts his glance on the devotees who are fasting."
The announcement was corrected and made accordingly.
Where else, apart from the lives of the Gunatit gurus, can we see such subtle supreme devotion?
